summary: As a Quality Doc SME, I want to initiate the Send for Review and Verification workflow on a Draft document and assign a reviewer so that the document enters formal review

acceptanceCriteria.text: [RP-FUNC-001] Quality Doc SME can authenticate to Veeva Vault QualityDocs using role-specific credentials
[NAV-001] After entering application URL and submitting valid credentials, user gains access to QualityDocs module landing page
[RP-FUNC-002] Quality Doc SME can navigate from QualityDocs landing page to Full Library view
[NAV-002] After clicking 'Full Library' in navigation, Full Library document search interface is displayed
[RP-FUNC-003] Quality Doc SME can search for document by name ('Test1 for Workflow') and see matching results
[NAV-003] Quality Doc SME can open document from search results and document detail page is displayed
[RP-FUNC-004] Document detail page confirms document is in Draft state
[RP-FUNC-005] Quality Doc SME can click 'Send for Review And Verification' user action on Draft document
[NAV-004] After clicking workflow action, workflow initiation dialog is displayed with reviewer assignment field
[RP-FUNC-006] Quality Doc SME can select reviewer from reviewer assignment field
[RP-FUNC-009] After submitting workflow initiation, workflow task is created and assigned to designated reviewer
[AR-001] After workflow submission, document status transitions from Draft to In Review
[AR-002] After workflow submission, reviewer sees assigned workflow task in Home view task list
[RP-DATA-001] Document status field displays 'In Review' after workflow is initiated
[GR-001] 'Send for Review And Verification' action is disabled/hidden when document is not in Draft state
[GR-002] Workflow initiation dialog prevents submission when no reviewer is selected (mandatory field)
[RP-ROLE-001] Only users with Quality Doc SME role can access and execute 'Send for Review And Verification' workflow action
[GR-006] Only authenticated users with valid credentials can access QualityDocs workflow functionality
[RP-NFR-003] System must enforce role-based access control — users without SME role cannot initiate workflow
[RISK-003] System shall prevent workflow initiation on documents not in Draft state
[RISK-004] System shall validate assigned reviewer account exists and has Reviewer role permissions before allowing workflow submission
[BR-001] 'Send for Review And Verification' workflow can only be initiated on documents in Draft state
[BR-002] Reviewer must be assigned when initiating workflow (mandatory field)
[RP-BIZ-002] Reviewer assignment field must contain valid reviewer account before system allows workflow submission

HP.description: Authenticate as Quality Doc SME, navigate to Full Library, search for 'Test1 for Workflow', open document, verify Draft state, initiate 'Send for Review And Verification' workflow, assign reviewer (Test_user01@partnersi-capgemini.com), submit, verify document status = 'In Review', verify workflow task created

AP.description: Direct navigation to QualityDocs URL with tab parameters (bypasses landing page navigation)

NEG.description: Attempt workflow initiation on document NOT in Draft state (e.g., In Review, Approved) → verify 'Send for Review And Verification' action is disabled/hidden
Attempt workflow initiation by user without Quality Doc SME role → verify action unavailable or authorization error
Attempt authentication with invalid credentials → verify access denied
Assign non-existent or invalid reviewer account → verify validation error before workflow submission
Search for non-existent document → verify 'No results found' message

ERR.description: Submit workflow initiation dialog with no reviewer selected (blank reviewer field) → verify error message 'Reviewer is required' or submission prevented
